notes: UNATTESTED (research 2026-07-04, re: Martha Taber Hedger's parent-too-young flag): this record carries no birth or death date at all, and no external source (WikiTree, Find A Grave, FamilySearch, Geni, or the Albert Stirling Adams 'Cheesman Family' manuscript) was found naming a 'Thomas John Cheeseman' among Peter Cheesman's or Martha Taber Hedger's children. Peter's 1788 will names sons Richard(4) and Thomas(4) only (the latter matching the separately-documented Thomas Cheesman, I182195863491, son of Ann Hanna Ellis). Given this family's well-documented habit of reusing given names across generations (explicitly remarked on in the Adams manuscript), this record may be a duplicate/ghost entry for the same Thomas Cheesman (b.1734) rather than a distinct person. Left as an open question; not merged or deleted in this pass. Full writeup: docs/research/ancestors/gen09-martha-taber-hedger-eliza-bolton-taber.md.
